printf '%s\n' 'timeline:'
nl -ba timeline.tsv
printf '%s\n' 'rejected:'
nl -ba rejected.tsv
cleanup
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '--- restored supplied-event outputs ---'
nl -ba timeline.tsv
nl -ba rejected.tsv
printf '%s\n' '--- no test residue ---'
test ! -e "$test_a" && test ! -e "$test_b" && printf 'clean\n'
